trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. It is the last trophy by design: there is no separate task, only the full set. Follow the roadmap in order and treat this as the finish line, not a goal of its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed — play the story and it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The chapter ends when its last mission does; there is nothing optional to do for this one.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, it unlocks when the chapter's final mission ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep playing the story; the trophy follows the chapter, not a side task.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The penultimate chapter ends with its final mission, and the trophy unlocks with it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. This is the story's last beat — the trophy is gold because it marks the end of the campaign, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so it unlocks in the natural course of the campaign.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist — play it through and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. Story mission; it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. Story mission; the trophy unlocks on completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport — play it through to the end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story mission; it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long one: it asks for the story, the activities, the collectibles and the stranger strands together, and it is the last gate before the platinum. Track it in the checklist and clean up one category at a time; the game itself shows the percentage.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. A stunt is any jump, near-miss, wheelie or drift the game counts — fast cars, ramps and long highways build the count quickly. It is a grind, not a skill test: keep playing and the number climbs.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The activities are the game's side pursuits — racing, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting, drone races and the rest. One try each is enough; you do not need to win any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the skill test of the set: each challenge has its own target score for gold. Practice one weapon at a time and use the range's own scoring feedback — the count PSN tracks is 42.

sources.label: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target: 42 challenges)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race; you need a win at every one, not just one win. Learn each course's line — the drones handle the same everywhere, so the course knowledge is the work.

sources.label: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target: 14 locations)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race counts, and a race counts once — so vary the events rather than repeating the one you like. Street races, circuit races and the drone races all feed the same count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activities; challenge Cal and out-fish him. The exact technique is not yet checked in the game — the guide says so plainly — but the task is a single head-to-head, not a grind.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Pick any arcade machine and play it through to its end. One completion is all it takes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Andy's strand ends with a final mission; complete the strand and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Complete Kenton's strand to its final mission and play it through.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Billy's strand ends with a final mission; complete it and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers are the side characters who give multi-mission strands — the count PSN tracks is 8. Work through them as you explore; each strand is several missions long.

sources.label: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target: 8 strands)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Complete Randy's strand to its final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Complete Tyrone's strand to its final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots. Meditation spots are scattered across Leonida; visit each one and meditate there. The count is 18 — use the map and check them off as you go.

sources.label: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target: 18 spots)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt asks for one specific animal, not a quota. Find it, take it down and the trophy unlocks — the exact animal and spot are not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; a set is complete when every card in it is found. Three full sets is the ask — collect as you explore rather than hunting them all at once.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game tagging — find the spots and tag them. One hundred is a lot, so fold it into exploration: tag every spot you pass.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small feats — stunts, races, collections and the rest. Fifty is a cumulative count across all of them, so it climbs as you play everything else.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then escape. This one can be missed: it needs your partner present and a 4-star wanted level, which is easiest to arrange during the story while your partner is with you. Build the wanted level, keep your partner close, then break line of sight and lose the heat.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level. This can be missed: it needs your partner, three shops in a row, and a wanted level that never drops. Plan a route of three nearby shops, hit them one after another, and keep moving — do it while your partner is available in the story.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive counts once. The count is 100 — drive everything you find, steal what you see, and the number climbs on its own.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus slows time; the trick is to trigger it where enemies are grouped, then drop five before it ends. A busy firefight is the best place to try.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This can be missed: it asks for a departure from the airport that is not on the schedule — a plane, taken when it should not be. Do it while the airport is open to you in the story; the exact aircraft and moment are not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — the tanks. The description is a joke; the task is about the Rhino tanks themselves. Find one in a mission or a wanted-level rampage and do what the game asks of it — the precise condition is not yet checked in the game, so treat the first encounter as a test run.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Stealth is the whole task: get in, take the goods and get out unseen. Go at a quiet hour, move slowly and avoid the cameras — one detection voids the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Five vaults, each one a full job with an escape. Plan the getaway before the robbery — the escape is part of the trophy, not an afterthought.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. One truck, one escape. Stop the truck, take the cash and break away clean.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The count is 52 — the map fills in as you visit each area. Drive the whole state and the trophy follows; the checklist's stage 3 is where this lives.

sources.label: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target: 52 areas)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Nine gangs, one operation each. The operations are the gangs' money-makers; hit one per gang and the trophy unlocks.

sources.label: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target: 9 gangs)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. It is a moment, not a mission — slow down and take it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive into a showroom, then out through the glass in style. One good run is all it takes.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. Follow through on the lane — a full game, not just a throw. The alley is the Kolt & Associates one, so go to that lane specifically.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it is a partnership beat, likely a story or activity moment with your partner. The exact trigger is not yet checked in the game; keep playing the partner content and it will come.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count to 500. This can be missed: it is about the choices you make, and the count PSN tracks runs to 500, so it is a long accumulation across the story. Play through the story making choices at every turn; the count builds as you go, and a choice not made cannot be made later.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. Fail something once, then succeed at it on the next attempt. It is a small, forgiving trophy — the game counts a second attempt that works.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. This is the game's oddity trophy — a strange event somewhere in Leonida. The exact event is not yet checked in the game; explore the odd corners of the map and it will find you.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. A drive-by with a melee weapon, not a gun — get close, swing, and keep driving. One knockdown is enough.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies; your contacts wash them for clean cash. The total is $250,000 — keep laundering as you earn and the trophy follows the money.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop counts and the total is cumulative. Buy cars, clothes, weapons and upgrades as you play — the money goes out as fast as it comes in.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. The count is 8 — garages are the properties that store your vehicles. Buy them as the money allows; they are also useful, not just a trophy.

sources.label: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target: 8 properties)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app takes your vehicles — register ten of them. Any ten vehicles count, so use the ones you drive most.
